risks.risk: Leak at the hose/connector or valve interface (common failure that photos can’t confirm).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video inflating a ball/tyre from near-flat to full, showing the connector seated and no air escaping around joints.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed to hold pressure (treat as needs testing).

risks.risk: Pump may not fit the buyer’s intended item (wrong nozzle/adapter for tyre/ball).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of all included nozzles/adapters and a close-up of the red connector end next to the target valve type.
risks.if_unproven: Price as limited compatibility (assume only one connector).

risks.risk: Low mileage/“no knock” may be untrue; internal wear could cause weak pumping or noise under load.
risks.proof: Ask for a clip of pumping under load (e.g., inflating a tyre/ball) with audio showing whether there’s knocking and whether pressure builds steadily.
Ask for a photo of any label/specs (pressure rating, max PSI/bar) or a gauge reading during inflation.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a basic low-to-mid pressure pump.

proof_requests: Video: inflate a ball/tyre from near-flat to full, showing the connector seated and no leaks at joints.
Photos: close-ups of the nozzle/valve interface and any adapters included (all ends).
Photo of any label/specs (pressure rating/max PSI/bar) or a gauge reading during inflation.
Audio clip while pumping to confirm “no knock” under load.
response.reason: The item type is clear (handheld air pump), but the key factors that determine value—working ability, leak-free performance, correct connector/adapters, and pressure capability—are not verifiable from the single photo.
